summary: Removed the FlyJitRuntime build-time HIP SDK dependency and its eager ELF dependency on libamdhip64. The runtime now uses a small, size-checked HIP ABI boundary and lazily opens/resolves the installed HIP runtime when a GPU wrapper is first invoked.

tests.what_was_measured: Five backend/CMake guardrails passed, including the regression that rejects HIP package discovery, HIP imported targets, and HIP header inclusion in FlyJitRuntime.

Full prepared native rebuild with pinned LLVM e2a39f504fee836e4def9581bed817ecc327b9dc, import from the rebuilt native tree, and the image's MI350X vector-add GPU smoke. Receipt: /job/native-build.json; build log: /job/native-build.log.
A fresh configure and FlyJitRuntime build completed while CMake HIP package discovery was disabled. Raw logs: /job/artifacts/j-054fd25873c8/sdkfree-config.log and sdkfree-runtime-build.log.

The rebuilt ELF has only standard C/C++ runtime DT_NEEDED entries and no undefined HIP symbols. The original prepared wheel had DT_NEEDED libamdhip64.so.7 and an /opt/rocm/lib RPATH. Raw logs are under /job/artifacts/j-054fd25873c8/.

Fresh GPU compilation/execution passed against the independent PyTorch a+b reference (max error threshold 1e-5). Emitted ISA targets amdgcn-amd-amdhsa-unknown-gfx950 and contains two global_load_dword instructions, v_add_f32_e32, and global_store_dword.
No libamdhip64 mapping existed before or after loading the rebuilt JIT runtime, demonstrating that ordinary library startup is lazy. Raw log: /job/artifacts/j-054fd25873c8/lazy-load-maps.log.

remaining_limitations: ROCm 7.2 is physically installed in this image. The SDK-free build claim was validated by disabling CMake HIP discovery, inspecting the successful compiler/link inputs, and checking the resulting ELF; a physically SDK-absent host was not available.
This change removes the HIP SDK dependency only from FlyJitRuntime. It does not implement the RFC's future CUDA/NVVM backend or dual-backend wheel selection.
GPU execution still correctly requires a compatible user-machine HIP runtime/driver; only build-time and eager-load dependencies were removed.
